boundaries: Labels and lifetimes share a lexical token; grammatical role remains with rustc.
Directive bodies are opaque physical-line tokens; M2 must validate them and provide non-directive fragment scanning.
Unicode 18 properties define boundaries, not exact older compiler Unicode acceptance or NFC normalization.
Attribute token trees are protected; procedural attribute item-body semantics and unstable macro 2.0 definitions are outside the supported contract.
